Character class provides a character’s most exciting capabilities. This chapter offers twelve classes, each of which contains four subclasses—all summarized below.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBarbarian0000.JournalEntryPage.z2RxKBICH6e6SkUT]{Barbarian}. Storm with Rage, and wade into hand-to-hand combat. Then follow the Path of the …

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBarbarian0000.JournalEntryPage.GvRPKO7EAbXB7TXM]{Berserker} to unleash raw violence.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBarbarian0000.JournalEntryPage.DZftqg73PEeRWY4J]{Wild Heart} to manifest kinship with animals.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBarbarian0000.JournalEntryPage.0NPflCZJaxFKhpXu]{World Tree} to tap into cosmic vitality.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBarbarian0000.JournalEntryPage.JZkVWnkmB47BwtLi]{Zealot} to rage in union with a god.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBard000000000.JournalEntryPage.ysmyEb6Euh5WLuA2]{Glamour} to weave beguiling Feywild magic.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbBard000000000.JournalEntryPage.iAZwiVfhgi8KdNAD]{Valor} to wield weapons with spells.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbCleric0000000.JournalEntryPage.r6CueEIytzMeRwwo]{War Domain} to inspire valor and chastise foes.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbRogue00000000.JournalEntryPage.gJV8iDqdNhRMLi5r]{Rogue}. Launch deadly Sneak Attacks while avoiding harm through stealth. Then embody the …

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbRogue00000000.JournalEntryPage.CT8AvC3zYbch3awT]{Assassin} to deliver ambushes and poison.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbRogue00000000.JournalEntryPage.ktzTbf5xQEp9qm2c]{Soulknife} to strike foes with psi blades.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbRogue00000000.JournalEntryPage.BiqRuwpBfYi32N2p]{Thief} to master infiltration and treasure hunting.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbSorcerer00000.JournalEntryPage.fsqRUA4acVXH4I3O]{Sorcerer}. Wield magic innate to your being, shaping the power to your will. Then channel …

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbSorcerer00000.JournalEntryPage.zqwAE59wEiY1bbtm]{Aberrant Sorcery} to use strange psionic magic.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbSorcerer00000.JournalEntryPage.Uk7haOmnUX48CBuY]{Clockwork Sorcery} to harness cosmic forces of order.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbSorcerer00000.JournalEntryPage.h9Qhn4HyJyAnK5b9]{Draconic Sorcery} to breathe the magic of dragons.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbSorcerer00000.JournalEntryPage.z7c2nyg00fI0CpxD]{Wild Magic} to unleash chaos magic.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.znue6EaGDDXgeQb0]{Warlock}. Cast spells derived from occult knowledge. Then form a pact with the …

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.dQHeGHmdwHIiODsr]{Archfey Patron} to teleport and wield fey magic.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.qheoOS8eeC6alP86]{Celestial Patron} to heal with heavenly magic.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.4km6CWhHArWi0klF]{Fiend Patron} to call on sinister powers.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWarlock000000.JournalEntryPage.qQFJw2Bq3aVeCVNp]{Great Old One Patron} to delve into forbidden lore.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.iMbdRPsxWV1pV61w]{Abjurer} to shield allies and banish foes.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.content.JournalEntry.phbWizard0000000.JournalEntryPage.ZKPFPF7JbjO73m4I]{Illusionist} to weave spells of deception.

Get Started Quickly with Premade Characters
